4. גם טראמפ שבנה באופן אישי על הפרס, לא ממש אהב את הבחירה הזו והוציא הודעה חריפה המגנה את הצעד. אבל טראמפ כמו טראמפ נעלב בעיקר ברמה האישית ופספס את העיקר. את החשוב.

* מעאד מאזן חמזה חסונה - מחבל נוח'בה בזרוע הצבאית של ארגון הטרור חמאס

item.title: [englishabuali] Saturday night article on the channel:
item.description:
Open
Saturday night article on the channel:
Dear politicians, we deserve more!

In two and a half weeks, we will go to the polls to elect a new Knesset.
Unfortunately, the level of political discourse in Israel is particularly low, as instead of discussing weighty issues of broad public interest, the main conversation (as expected) revolves around a single issue:

“Only Bibi/Anyone but Bibi”

The State of Israel is currently facing broad and fundamental challenges regarding its future. Weighty questions are on the table, but they receive no attention in the discourse.
Party leaders from both the right and the left are not offering solutions to the burning issues facing Israel.
Here are a few:

1. The defeat of Hamas. How should it be achieved?
2. The defeat of Hezbollah. How should it be achieved?
3. Judea and Samaria – should construction be advanced, do you support a Palestinian state?
4. The Iranian arena – how should we act given the current situation?

The head of the Yisrael Beiteinu party, Avigdor Lieberman, has in the past two weeks raised the idea of bringing Jordanian forces into Judea and Samaria – some may think this is a huge folly, others may think it’s an excellent idea – but he is about the only one who has brought up an issue beyond “Only Bibi/Anyone but Bibi” in the past two weeks.

Saying what’s wrong is easy. The real wisdom is to propose a solution, a detailed plan for each and every issue, as part of every party’s platform – and to earn the voter’s trust on that basis.

It may be naïve of me to think the situation can be changed, but I am calling out here first and foremost to the politicians themselves, the heads of the various parties, and also to the journalists who interview them:

Give us answers, positions, detailed plans, clear solutions to the main issues Israel is facing!!!
We deserve it!
It’s basic!

Tell us how to make the country better.
If you have a successful solution, share it with the public. Let’s raise the level of discussion, bring up ideas on the burning issues – ideas that will benefit the State of Israel regardless of the makeup of the next government.
A knife is only sharpened on the thigh of its companion.

1. How do you eliminate Hamas? There are more than a million Hamas supporters in the Strip – you can’t kill them, and no country wants, at least publicly, to take them in. Every party leader must propose and present a plan.

2. The same goes for Hezbollah. The Lebanese army doesn’t want to and can’t disarm Hezbollah. What do you propose? Should the IDF enter Beirut to do the job? Do you have another solution? Go ahead, propose it!

3. Are you for a Palestinian state? Against? For construction in E1 between Ma’ale Adumim and Jerusalem? For the farms? Against?

4. How do you want to topple the regime in Iran? Attack? What to attack? Economic strangulation?

Be worthy of your voters’ voices! Publish your positions! If you have a good idea, share it! That way, even if you’re not elected, maybe whoever is will work to implement your good idea.
We deserve a higher level of discourse, especially as we enter the home stretch before the elections.
Enough with the gutter talk!

I invite all parties to send me a single slide with a concise summary of their platform on the four issues I mentioned above.
I will publish them free of charge on my channel, for the sake of raising the level of political discourse in the country.
